title: On the Existence of Optimal (v,5,1) and (v,6,1) Binary Cyclically Permutable Constant-Weight Codes
read_scope: Parent read pp.1–4 through functions.read PDF conversion: definitions, equivalences, known-results exception list and search range. No full-paper read claimed.

passages.claim: Perfect CPCW codes are equivalent to strictly cyclic 2-(v,k,1) designs and cyclic difference families.

passages.quote: According to [26], a (20t + 1, 5, 1) difference family exists for 1 ≤ t ≤ 50 except possibly for t = 16, 25, 31, 34, 40, 45.

passages.claim: The present search covers k=5 and v≤181, hence none of the six orders.
